thread:
alana_pm: Idea: add a small read-only 'routing snapshot' on saved queries. Shows friendly tier, estimated token burn per-run, and a stability/confidence indicator. Useful when choosing model defaults during rollouts. Thoughts?

noah_platform: Sounds good. Keep it off by default and behind a feature flag. Backend should return an opaque preview token, not model names. Suggested fields: tier_label, est_tokens, confidence (low/med/high), sla_flag.

ria_design: UX: tiny pill row under the query title, with an info icon. Clicking opens a micro-panel with a 3-line summary and a "preview" button. Avoid heavy charts for first pass.

omar_sre: Agree on obfuscation. Also: cap preview calls to 10/org/day and require audits for simulate calls. We should show a "data confidence" tooltip when traffic is low.

lee_devex: For simulate we can provide a sandbox API that runs the routing decision but returns only percentile estimates (p50/p95) for latency and token cost. No internal IDs. Example response string: "p50: 120ms, p95: 420ms, est_tokens: ~900"

infra-bot: telemetry: routing_snapshot.viewed { saved_query: SQ-2102 }

noah_platform: Backend sketch: GET /saved_queries/:id?routing_snapshot=true returns flat strings: routing_label, est_tokens, confidence, sla. POST /saved_queries/:id/preview with payload/sample returns preview_id which expires in 1m. Rate limit per org.

ria_design: I'll mock three visual states: unknown (no hint), friendly hint, and low-confidence warning. Also include microcopy: "Estimates are approximate and based on recent traffic patterns."

omar_sre: Legal check: confirm wording doesn't imply guaranteed performance. Also add denylist for orgs with sensitive compliance profiles.

lee_devex: Telemetry events to add: routing_snapshot.preview.request, routing_snapshot.preview.complete, routing_snapshot.view.failed. Include hashed org id and preview_mode.

alana_pm: Action items: Ria -> mocks by Tue; Noah -> API PR + throttling by Thu; Omar -> legal/security signoff; Lee -> telemetry schema. We'll pilot with internal teams first.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: routing-snapshot-service v0.1 deployed to staging

noah_platform: Opening draft PR with API contract and a simple mock impl so frontend can iterate against staging.

alana_pm: Nice work 8D
